name: acquires and returns only supplied connection objects
blocks an exhausted pool and resumes after a return
input: one checked-out connection and one waiting worker
test:
import threading
import time

class Connection:
    pass

resource = Connection()
pool = ConnectionPool([resource])
held = pool.acquire()
started = threading.Event()
received = []

def worker():
    started.set()
    connection = pool.acquire()
    received.append(connection)
    pool.release(connection)

thread = threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True)
thread.start()
assert started.wait(1)
time.sleep(0.05)
assert thread.is_alive()
pool.release(held)
thread.join(1)
assert not thread.is_alive()
assert received == [resource]
